# sendgrid_single_send (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid Marketing Campaigns Single Send: a one-time campaign email.

~> Setting `send_at` to a real timestamp schedules the Single Send to actually go out at that time — this is a real side effect, not just metadata. Setting it to `"now"` sends it immediately. Once a Single Send has been sent, it can no longer be updated or scheduled again through this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_single_send" "spring_sale" {
  name = "spring-sale-2026"

  send_to = {
    list_ids = [sendgrid_list.newsletter.id]
  }

  email_config = {
    subject              = "Spring Sale is here!"
    html_content         = "<p>Save 20% this week only.</p>"
    suppression_group_id = 12345
  }

  # Omit send_at to leave this as an unscheduled draft. Setting it schedules
  # (or, with "now", immediately sends) the campaign.
  # send_at = "2026-03-01T09:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_config` (Attributes) The content of this Single Send. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_config))
- `name` (String) The Single Send's name.
- `send_to` (Attributes) The recipients of this Single Send. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--send_to))

### Optional

- `categories` (List of String) Categories to associate with this Single Send, for filtering statistics. Up to 10.
- `send_at` (String) An ISO 8601 date-time to schedule this Single Send for, or the literal string `"now"` to send it immediately. Leave unset to keep it as an unscheduled draft.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Single Send's UUID.
- `status` (String) The Single Send's status: `draft`, `scheduled`, or `triggered`.

<a id="nestedatt--email_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_config`

Optional:

- `custom_unsubscribe_url` (String) A custom unsubscribe URL. Required unless `suppression_group_id` is set.
- `design_id` (String) A saved design ID, used in place of `html_content`/`plain_content`/`subject`.
- `editor` (String) The editor used in the SendGrid UI: `code` or `design`.
- `generate_plain_content` (Boolean) If true, `plain_content` is always regenerated from `html_content`.
- `html_content` (String) The HTML content. Omit when using `design_id`.
- `ip_pool` (String) The name of the IP pool to send from.
- `plain_content` (String) The plain-text content. Generated from `html_content` unless `generate_plain_content` is `false`.
- `sender_id` (Number) The verified sender ID.
- `subject` (String) The subject line. Omit when using `design_id`.
- `suppression_group_id` (Number) The unsubscribe group ID. Required unless `custom_unsubscribe_url` is set.


<a id="nestedatt--send_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `send_to`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Send to all contacts. If false, at least one of `list_ids` or `segment_ids` is required before scheduling.
- `list_ids` (List of String) Recipient list IDs. Up to 50.
- `segment_ids` (List of String) Recipient segment IDs. Up to 10.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_single_send.spring_sale <single_send_id>
```
